decisive_items: A lateral flow COVID-19 antigen test and confirmatory RT-PCR were both positive.
He denied head injury, substance use, or stressors and had no family history of psychiatric illness.
He exhibited circumstantial thought, grandiose delusions (“I am a prophet of God”), persecutory delusions, and both auditory (“gunshots”) and visual (a mob) hallucinations.
response.rationale: Confirmed acute SARS-CoV-2 infection with new-onset psychotic symptoms and no alternative structural, toxic, or metabolic explanation strongly supports COVID-19 psychosis; mercury exposure is only speculative and lacks a characteristic mercury toxidrome.

rejected.why: Potential occupational mercury exposure is the only link, but there is no confirmed exposure and no characteristic mercury poisoning signs such as tremor, ataxia, or gastrointestinal symptoms; confirmed COVID-19 is a more direct and likely cause of the acute psychosis.
